fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, the listing is presented and handled by a marina (Knotty Oar Marina) offering winterization, storage and test drives from a dealer showroom, so it reads as dealer or brokered stock rather than a private owner sale.
findings: Black side panels on both sides look glossy and clean
Gray vinyl seating visible over the rails looks clean
Pontoon tubes show an even, uniform finish with no visible scum or waterline staining
Front deck seagrass flooring looks clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crest 240 pontoon. The black panels and seating already look sharp in the photos. If you ever want a pre-sale wash and tube polish, we come to you, so let us know if you'd like a quote.
